text:
maria: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 503s for hosted inference since ~09:12 UTC. CS ticket shows sudden spike in upstream worker exits, looks like segfaults during prefetch.

alex: Saw the alerts too. Gateway error rate jumped and autoscaler started restarting some pods. Collecting pod logs now.

maria: Customer notes: requests time out after 10s, then 503. Auth tokens still valid, no billing anomalies in their account.

alex: Paste of recent container log excerpt:```
[2026-02-14T09:11:58Z] runtime: segfault at 0x7f8a3c4b
[2026-02-14T09:11:58Z] signal 11 (SIGSEGV), code 1 (SEGV_MAPERR)
[2026-02-14T09:11:58Z] backtrace: ./infer_runner(+0x1a3f2) [0x55f1a3f2]
[2026-02-14T09:11:59Z] NVML: GPU 0: out of memory while prefetching KV cache
[2026-02-14T09:12:00Z] supervisor: container exit code 139, restarting
```

todd: That NVML OOM on GPU during a KV prefetch aligns with the segfault. Which kernel build? We rolled quant swap yesterday night to v2.3.

ben: Runtime was on quant-runtime:2.3.1 (hotfix). We saw a small mem accounting delta on 2.3 vs 2.2 in canary but nothing crashing. Repro steps I ran: heavy embed burst + large context (50k tokens) -> one worker OOMed on prefetch.

maria: CS asked for a reproducible checklist to escalate to customer. They hit it via multiplexed embed stream at p95.

alex: Short repro outline for next 30m: send multiplexed embed payloads (batch size 64) with a 45k token context, toolcalls disabled, force cold-prefetch flag. I can run against a dev pool.

maya: Assigning SRE-runbook: prioritize coredump collection, kernel logs, and GPU diagnostics. Steps: 1) capture container core (if present) from node /var/crash, 2) nvmlDriver log, 3) dmesg for GPU pagefaults, 4) runtime backtrace with gdb.

ben: I grabbed a core from one of the nodes: /var/crash/infer-uuid-7163/core. Quick gdb output (symbols stripped):```
#0  0x00007f8a3c4b in ?? ()
#1  0x55f1a2de in kv_prefetch(void*)
#2  0x55f1b0aa in thread_start
```
Looks like kv_prefetch is dereferencing an invalid pointer after an NVML OOM path.

alex: For mitigation, I'm rolling a temporary config change: reduce prefetch parallelism from 8 -> 2 and cap per-worker prefetch memory to 6GB in the pool config. Pushing now.

ops_bot: deploy:config-change applied to pool hosted-prod-3 by alex at 2026-02-14T09:18:12Z :white_check_mark:

maria: CS update: customers see error rate drop after the config change, some requests still return 503 during ongoing drain.

ben: Filing runtime revert/patch ticket: RUNTIME-2481. Proposed fix: handle NVML OOM path in kv_prefetch gracefully (free partial allocations + fail prefetch with controlled error) and add guard that avoids deref after partial state.

maya: Also add alert rule for "prefetch OOMs leading to SIGSEGV" aggregated across nodes so we catch before customer impact spikes.

alex: Quick follow-ups: (1) collect node-level nvml logs for the last 24h and upload to s3://redwood-triage/7163219876/, (2) run the repro in dev with preload-sanitizers on, (3) contact top-impacted CS accounts with ETA.

maria: I'll do customer comms. Thanks everyone — keeping thread open for final RCA and patch PR.

ben: Opening PR with unit test for partial-prefetch cleanup, linking to RUNTIME-2481. ETA EOD.

alex: Noted. If anything spikes again @channel ping me and i'll escalate to infra oncall. :thumbsup:

maria: Closing for now, will update when PR merged or if new errors surface. :white_check_mark:
